### A Behind-the-Scenes Look
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-03-or-14-or-05-1315174.html
Passage: Daniel 10:12-14
Points:
- Spiritual warfare frequently takes place behind the scenes in the unseen realm when believers pray.
- God heard Daniel's request from the very first day he humbled himself, even though the visible answer took weeks to arrive.
- A demonic ruler opposed the heavenly messenger until the archangel Michael arrived to assist him.
- Apparent delays in prayer are not necessarily divine denials, so Christians must persist in prayer.
